Walking on gravel might look uncomfortable, but it’s actually one of my favorite ways to wake up the muscles in my feet. 🪨🌿 Our feet weren’t designed to spend every day on perfectly flat surfaces. Walking on uneven ground, like the gravel around the farm, challenges the small muscles in your feet and ankles, improves balance, and can help build stronger, more resilient feet. 👣✨ It definitely takes some getting used to, but for me it’s just another part of farm life. 🤎 Have you ever tried walking on gravel?  #FootHealth #NaturalMovement #CountryLiving #HealthyFeet #strongmen
